voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Don't look at the dolls. They're already looking at you.
lines.beat_before: hook: gliding into the canal at dusk; the first dolls hang from the trees, facing the water

lines.text: Xochimilco, Mexico City. For about fifty years, one man lived alone on this little island in the canals.
lines.beat_before: more dolls; the reeds; the fence of sticks hung with heads

lines.text: Don Julián Santana Barrera said a girl had drowned nearby. He hung dolls in the trees, for her.
lines.beat_before: a tree full of dolls passes close; they swing

lines.text: Hundreds of them. He pulled them out of the canals, and out of the trash.
lines.beat_before: the hut with dolls nailed to its walls

lines.text: Visitors say the dolls whisper. That their heads turn when a boat goes by.
lines.beat_before: one doll near the boat turns its head, slowly, in plain sight

lines.text: Some say the girl was real. Others say he only dreamed her. No record of her has been found.
lines.beat_before: the end of the island; the boat starts to turn

lines.text: In two thousand one, he was found drowned. In the same canal, his family says.
lines.beat_before: the boat turns all the way round; black water

lines.text: Now, on the way back. Look at the same dolls.
lines.beat_before: the way back, closer to the bank: the same dolls, all facing the boat; one floats beside us
the camera tilts down to the black water: in the reflection, a doll hangs right above us, looking down
